The modern, technical design lines are outfitted in premium suede and mesh, with ABZORB cushioning at the heel and forefoot providing the unmistakable feeling of peerless comfort. A new, seasonal colorway explores natural tones from the Fall/Winter palette. The 992's mesh, suede, and leather construction is rendered in shades of deep green and brown, paired with a brown midsole.

products.name: 204L
products.description:
Shop the full 204L collection

Enter the 204L: an unexpected interpretation of 2000s running-inspired style. This low-profile silhouette blends the slim structure of '70s running shoes with tech-inspired texture of premium suede. Pulling design elements from past and present New Balance favorites, the 204L feels familiar, yet new. Its sleek proportions, accented with arced lines across the overlay, make the 204L both unique and easy to wear.

Looking for other options? Shop the 740

The original 740 was the kind of daily runner that would be worn into the ground with heavy miles and bought all over again. This longtime fan favorite returns from the archives, poised to inspire a whole new generation of devotees. The 740 combines familiar elements of 2000s running-inspiration – an open knit mesh upper, segmented midsole, and a streamlined silhouette – with flourishes like two-tone color mesh and angular overlays, that give the 740 a unique visual identity. Whether you’re discovering, or rediscovering, the 740 is ready to become your next favorite shoe.

products.name: 1080v15
products.description: We're in it for the long run. The 1080v15 is everything that you’ve come to rely on in an everyday running shoe, delivered by an all-new cushioning technology designed for long-lasting performance, with enhanced cushioning and energy return. This innovative approach is complemented with a total visual makeover. It’s a whole new way of looking at the most comfortable running shoe we can make.

products.name: Made in USA 1300
products.description: Classic everyday. The legendary 1300 makes its return to the Made in USA rotation. The ENCAP equipped sole unit, premium materials, and easy to wear style that made the original 1300 a masterpiece of running shoe design feature a mesh upper, overlaid with suede, and outfitted in classic, core colorways.

products.name: ABZORB 2010
products.description: The ABZORB 2010 combines the excitement of a progressive, all-new style with a sense of the familiar. The segmented ABZORB sole unit, a signature feature of several 2000s-era fan favorites, features more expansive proportions, becoming the centerpiece of this new design.

products.name: Made in USA 992 Core
products.description: The legendary 992 returns to the Made in USA Collection. This fan-favorite silhouette remains as classic as ever. The modern, technical design lines are outfitted in premium suede and mesh, with ABZORB cushioning at the heel and forefoot providing the unmistakable feeling of peerless comfort. The Made in USA 992 Core features a selection of essential colorways: grey, black, navy blue, and white.

products.name: Kawhi V
products.description: Introducing the KAWHI V, the new signature shoe built for one of the best to ever play the game. Designed with Kawhi himself, and tailored to his specifications, the KAWHI V combines some of the best design elements of previous models and lowers the collar for greater range of motion. Crafted to complement his playing style, a dual-density FuelCell midsole and Y-shaped plate deliver a responsive and energetic underfoot for his explosive cuts, while a molded sidewall, TPU heel clip, and unique multi-directional tread add stability and control for his intensive two-way game. With a mesh upper, synthetic leather overlays, and a lightweight PU cage, the KAWHI V is the perfect combination of premium style, comfort, and performance.

products.name: 9060R
products.description: The 9060R is the next generation of the 9060.The updated upper preserves the model’s premium feel while enhancing its appeal through open saddle mesh, split vamp overlays, and authentic New Balance DNA. Modern details like an extended mudguard and debossed print give the silhouette a sleek, speedy look.

products.name: Maxey V1
products.description: Introducing the Maxey v1, Tyrese Maxey’s first signature shoe. Designed in collaboration with the man himself, the Maxey v1 is built for players with relentless energy and unstoppable speed. A FuelCell midsole provides a propulsive feel while QUIXRAIL technology combines with a reinforced sidewall and TPU shank for stability during quick cuts and directional changes.

products.name: Made in UK 991V2 Elevated Neutrals
products.description: The Made in UK ‘Elevated Neutrals’ pack is a sleek twist on the effortless versatility of neutral tones. The sleek look of a black waffle mesh upper is overlaid with both deep and medium toned pig suede, with synthetic leather and reflective accents providing a flash of tech running-inspired detail.

products.name: P400 Low
products.description: The P400 Low utilizes the same premium, dual density cushioning as the high-top, but lowers the collar for greater mobility. ‘N’ Lock technology is added for secure lockdown feel while an updated TPU plate in the forefoot provides a propulsive feel for quick turns and fast cuts.

products.name: T500
products.description: Originally released in 1982, the T500 was designed to bring superior quality to a versatile on-court style. While the reintroduced T500 is designed more for leisure than competition, everything that made the T500 a great tennis shoe then, makes it a timeless classic now. The upper features pigskin suede and nubuck construction and perforated toebox detailing, for a premium take on the familiar look. A gum midsole offers an understated hint of 1980s tech, that stands out from the vulcanized soles of older court models.

products.name: 880R
products.description: The 880R combines ABZORB cushioning and compression resistance with a 2000's running-inspired design for all-day comfort and style.

products.name: NB Numeric 480
products.description: Inspired by the New Balance BB680, production of the original 480 began in 1983 and quickly became a favorite in the basketball community. Forty years later, New Balance Numeric brought the 480’s coveted cushioning from the court to the streets adding a double-layered, widened toe cap for durability, a modified tread for improved traction, and sturdy heel counter for stability and support. For this release, a full-grain leather and ballistic mesh upper utilizes GORE-TEX technology for a weatherproof take on the re-mixed classic.

products.name: Made in USA 990v4
products.description:
The 990’s original designers were tasked with creating the single best running shoe on the market. The finished product more than lived up to its billing. When it hit shelves for the first time in 1982 the 990 sported an elegantly understated grey colorway, and a then unheard of three-figure price tag. For avid runners and ahead of the curve tastemakers alike, the 990 was a mark of quality and superior taste. There have been updates to the design since ’82, and more color options, but the 990’s aspirational status symbol aura has never changed. Simply put, the 990 is the shoe so good, that we’ve never stopped making it. The MADE in USA 990v4, originally introduced in 2016, continued to refine the v3's modernization of the silhouette. This core colorway features a premium pigskin suede and mesh upper in classic navy.

New Balance MADE U.S. footwear contains a domestic value of 70% or more. MADE makes up a limited portion of New Balance’s U.S. sales.

products.name: P350
products.description: The new P350 is built for players who turn moments into highlights. The moves, quick cuts and, hesitations that turn defenders inside out don’t just happen though. They’re created by agility and explosive power. That’s why the P350 combines lightweight breathability with support designed for movement in every direction.

products.name: TDS Niobium C1
products.description: New Balance Tokyo Design Studio originally introduced the Niobium concept shoe in 2020—a transformable shoe that started as a slip-on mule and could be built up to a waterproof boot. With the Tokyo Design Studio Niobium Concept 1, the design has evolved into a single piece of footwear that transforms across three stages: a waterproof boot, an outdoor mule, and an indoor slipper. Featuring stretch rip-stop material, welded PU overlays, and a zipper down the tongue and around the heel for assembly, this versatile shoe is informed by years of New Balance craftsmanship to deliver exceptional comfort and support for all-day wear throughout the year.

products.name: Made in USA 990v6
products.description:
The designers of the first 990 were tasked with creating the single best running shoe on the market. The MADE in USA 990v6 embraces this original mandate, with a series of performance-inspired updates. The upper dispenses with the standard midfoot saddle, allowing the pigskin and synthetic overlays to flow from heel to toe across the mesh underlay, for a speedy, streamlined look. While the evolved design marks one of the most dramatic changes from one generation model to the next that the 990 has ever seen, the greatest leap forward occurs on the inside. The addition of FuelCell midsole cushioning means that the evolution of the 990 can be felt as much as it can be seen.

New Balance MADE contains a domestic value of 70% or more. MADE makes up a limited portion of New Balance’s US sales.

Enter a new dimension with the 983. A reimagination of 2000s performance running, the 983 draws on elements from classic New Balance models to create something wholly new and progressive. An exploration of texture, the elliptic shape of the 983's ABZORB SBS pods pairs with waved form along its out- and mid- sole, complementing the molded ‘N’ logo on the saddle and rounded overlays along the upper. The resulting design is sculptural, sophisticated, and streamlined.

‘The most New Balance shoe ever’ says it all, right? No, actually. The 574 might be our unlikeliest icon. The 574 was built to be a reliable shoe that could do a lot of different things well rather than as a platform for revolutionary technology, or as a premium materials showcase. This unassuming, unpretentious versatility is exactly what launched the 574 into the ranks of all-time greats. A hybrid road/trail design built on a wider last than the previous generation’s narrow racing silhouettes, the 574 offered a uniquely versatile mix of new, different, uncomplicated, rugged, durable, and comfortable that was adopted as a closet staple across the globe. That’s why today, the 574 is synonymous with the boundary defying New Balance style, and worn by anyone.

products.name: 3000v8 TPU
products.description:
The 3000v8 is an elite-level molded TPU baseball spike. It features a full-length Fresh Foam midsole for exceptional underfoot comfort, paired with a technical TPU heel clip for a locked-in look and feel.

For pitchers with excessive toe drag, we recommend using a toe-protection product to extend the life of your cleat.

products.name: Made in USA 1240v1
products.description:
Premium materials and an ultra-cushioned Fresh Foam midsole make these lightweight runners an everyday favorite. The engineered mesh upper blends structure and breathability, ensuring all-day comfort and support, while a new dual insert system offers personalized fit customization to accommodate a variety of foot shapes and needs.

New Balance Made in USA footwear contains a domestic value of 70% or more. Made in USA makes up a limited portion of New Balance’s US sales.

products.name: AC Runner
products.description:
Shop all AC Runner colors

Even if running isn’t your sport, it’s part of the game. The AC Runner is made for the conditioning runs, training, and drills that turn into difference-making plays on game day. The comfort-focused cushioning, stability, and support is combined with sleek, fashion-forward design. It’s performance and statement making style for every part of an athlete’s day, on and off the field.

products.name: FuelCell 796v5
products.description: Lightweight, durable, and loaded with modern features, these tennis shoes are built for performance on and off the court.

products.name: 442 Elite IN LS V3
products.description: Play 442. Crafted for quality, the updated 442 combines modern craft with timeless design. A premium nubuck upper with plush forefoot quilting adds a new dimension of comfort. The combination of classic and contemporary continues onto the outsole, where responsive, elite-level rubber adds stability and traction on indoor and hardcourt surfaces. The new 442 v3, some things just never go out of fashion.

products.name: FuelCell Rebel Trail
products.description: For trail runners who like a close-to-the-ground feel, the FuelCell Rebel Trail balances traction, support and durability with a dynamic underfoot experience.

products.name: EveryMatch PKL
products.description: These versatile shoes are designed for the casual pickleball player with light, breathable mesh, pickleball branding on the heel and midsole, and a durable rubber outsole.

products.name: Coco Delray
products.description:
This style runs narrow. You may prefer to choose a wider width size.

Influenced by the Florida city where Coco Gauff grew up and trained, The Coco Delray is designed for every player and every court. This versatile shoe performs on a range of surfaces, while being equally at home off the court. It offers a unique combination of hard-wearing durability and the lightweight look and feel offered by a low-ankle collar and responsive FuelCell midsole.
